maria_support: Hey team — customer Acme (org_orgAcme123) says the Console shows $200 trial credits under Billing > Credits but their API invoices show no credit being applied, they're getting billed for token usage. Attached customer repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX' -H 'X-Redwood-Org: org_orgAcme123' -d '{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}' ; request_id: rq_01GabcXYZ ; invoice_ref: inv_2026_04_12_99
maria_support: I already checked the console UI screenshot and the Billing page shows "Trial credit: $200 — Expires 2026-05-01". Customer insists API shows full charges. Any quick checks before I ask them for more logs?
alex_k: Can you confirm which API key they used? org header vs key-bound-org mismatch can cause credits not to apply. Also need the full request_id and timestamp.
maria_support: They used a key that starts sk-live-..., I asked for the last 4 chars, they gave "-9P3f". Request ID above is what they provided. Timestamp for that request is 2026-04-12T15:18:03Z.
maya_r: Two quick diagnostics:
1) Ask them to call GET /v1/credits with the same key and org header and paste response.
2) Ask them to call GET /v1/account (returns account_id/org_id bound to key). If the key is tied to a different org, credits won't apply.
maria_support: Customer ran both, here are snippets:
```
GET /v1/credits -> 200 { "available_credits": 200.00, "currency": "USD", "eligible_orgs": ["org_orgAcme123"] }
GET /v1/account -> 200 { "org_id": "org_orgAcme456", "key_owner": "project_x" }
```
maria_support: So the key is bound to org_orgAcme456 but console shows credits on org_orgAcme123 — looks like org mismatch.
jordan_m: This looks like the cross-org key binding bug we saw last month. There's a migration/cleanup job that maps legacy project keys to orgs — if that job hasn't run for this tenant, the key will still be attached to the old org. Check the last run of sync_billing_credits.
alex_k: Can you check billing logs for that request_id? If credits didn't apply, there should be an entry: "billing.apply_credit: false reason: org_mismatch". If so we can either run the migration for that org or manually create a billing adjustment.
maria_support: I pulled billing logs — found: billing.apply_credit false; reason="key_org_mismatch"; policy=trial_credit; logged at 2026-04-12T15:18:03Z; worker=billing-sync-3
alex_k: OK. Short term: we can manually add a credit usage record against org_orgAcme456 to reimburse the customer and then run migration. Long term: fix is to re-run sync_billing_credits for org_orgAcme123 and rebind keys. Jordan, can you run the migration for this org? If not, what's ETA?
jordan_m: I can trigger a targeted run for that org. Will do a dry-run first then apply. ETA: start dry-run in ~30m, full migration in next maintenance window if dry-run looks good. If customer needs immediate relief we'll create ad-hoc credit entry (billing-team action). I'll coordinate with finance.
support_bot: Created ticket INC-4421 linking customer Acme, billing logs, request_id rq_01GabcXYZ, assigned to alex_k and jordan_m.
alex_k: I'll prep the manual credit adjustment PR and route to finance for approval. Estimated time to issue credit: ~2 hours after approval.
maya_r: I'll message the customer: explain root cause (API key bound to different org), temporary workaround (we'll issue manual credit, and optionally rebind key), and ETA. maria, can you confirm they want the immediate reimbursement? :thumbsup:
maria_support: Customer confirmed they want immediate reimbursement, please proceed. Also asked for steps to prevent this for future — can we add a UI warning when Billing credits exist on a different org than the active key?
jordan_m: Good idea. I'll file a follow-up ticket to surface a warning in the Console and add a unit test for key->org binding during onboarding. For now I'll run the targeted migration and post logs here.
alex_k: Following up — credit adjustment PR created, awaiting finance approval. Once approved I'll post the adjustment id here. :rocket:
maria_support: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer and close the support ticket once adjustment is confirmed.
